Topics.heading: Teaching topics
Topics.intro: Many teaching concerns touch more than one step of the journey. The topic pages bring together what the Teaching Hub and the University of Bern offer in different places. The teaching journey shows the process; the topics show what belongs to a concern.
Topics.matrixHint: Where each core topic appears in the teaching cycle. Circle size = number of pages; fewer than 5 pages is too thin for a topic page.
